fade out
fade back in, scouts are gone
You sounded pretty serious back there.
We've stumbled upon a most perplexing situation...
The scouts who just left came in to report that they've found
The supplies were thoroughly raided, though only certain things were taken. Armor, weapons, ammunitions, medical kits, anything that could be used for combat and other combat-related things.
Food, building materials and even some rather important Peitho schematics that our scouts managed to find were left completely untouched.
I don't see what's wrong with all of this. Just means that Peitho's got another enemy, and this group's doing a damn good job at hitting 'em hard!
Unfortunately, we can't afford to be so blindly optimistic.
Given the nature of their looting, they're looking for weapons and armor, things to arm people with.
Maybe there's another resistance cell forming somewhere else! They're taking weapons and armor to arm the ordinary people so they can resist Peitho too!
While that is possible, this may be a group of people who just want to take power away from Peitho and then take their place. Not all enemies of our enemies are necessarily our friends.

There were other resistance cells before the failed coup as well, and we had secret channels we used to keep in communication. If another resistance cell would have formed, I'm sure they'd know how to get in touch with us.
That is why I'm inclined to believe this is not the work of fellow resistance members.
So we're just gonna automatically assume they're enemies?
No. All we can assume is that they're not necessarily on our side. For beyond that, that's where we need your help.
Your mission, should you choose to accept it, is to go out and try to trace back this mysterious group's identity.
I hate to ask more of you, but if you could find out anything like the location of some kind of hideout, or who their leader is, that would make our jobs a lot easier too...
Our hands are unfortunately already full trying to deal with Peitho as is.
We can do it, right guys?
Where exactly did this Peitho unit get ambushed, again?
In the forest nearby, not too far from our outpost actually. However, the perpetrators seemed to have disappeared deep into the forest.
A good hiding place for most people, but not when you've got me hunting you. If they're hiding somewhere in the forest, we'll find them for sure!
Rida hunter too!
It's not much compared to the other two, but I was given some basic tracking training when I was trained to be a guard.
Seems like we're fairly well equipped for the mission then!
I'm relieved to hear all this. Your assistance is once again, very much appreciated.
I leave this mission in your capable hands.
Consider it done!
